controls.scope: All Popen/kill/identity/time/progress interventions use mocks and controlled nonsecret env. No actual child, signal, observer, renderer/model, known-case execution or binary invocation.

identityAndProvenance: Popen start_new_session=true; record exact spawnedPID immediately; bind kernel birth/ppid/pgid twice and require parent=this actual parent and group=childPID.

Normal terminal poll is recorded as the source that first obtained status. Subsequent Popen.wait is explicitly cached, not a second independent kernel reap. All waits retain before-status, actual timeout/return and source.
Only the verified direct controller PID is signalled; process group is verified as part of identity, never assumed clean or signalled by a guessed name/group.

Watchdog/interrupt/other intervention remains adverse even if cleanup later obtains exit0. Before each TERM/KILL, reverify the same bound identity; wait60/5 unchanged. PID reuse or birth/parent/group uncertainty forbids the signal.

Terminal distinguishes childIdentityUnresolved, unresolved liveness/status, cached poll/wait provenance and possible growing controller log. Unknown birth remains unresolved even if poll0 is later obtained.

Launch/log/terminal are x-exclusive; updates use only own exclusively-created descriptors. Prior artifacts are never overwritten. Config bytes/SHA, repository HEAD/clean and exact parent source-to-Q binding are retained.
CLI recording exceptions are conservatively CHILD_STATE_UNKNOWN, not falsely labelled no-child-started.
meaningfulBranches: watchdog TERM then wait0 still adverse
unknown cleanup identity and unknown initialbirth
